name: ZeroB ULTRA UV
summary: The ZeroB Ultra UV is a compact UV + UF water purifier that delivers safe and hygienic drinking water by eliminating bacteria, viruses, and fine impurities.
intro: The ZeroB Ultra UV is a compact and stylish UV + UF water purifier designed to provide safe, healthy drinking water every day. Equipped with Next Gen UV technology and Ultra Filtration (UF), it effectively removes bacteria, viruses, and microscopic impurities while preserving water quality. Its detachable 6-litre storage tank ensures easy cleaning, while smart LED indicators keep you informed of the purifier's status. With a wall-mountable design, low power consumption, and modern aesthetics, the ZeroB Ultra UV is the ideal choice for homes using municipal or pre-treated water.
features: UV + UF Dual Purification for safe, hygienic drinking water
Next Gen UV Technology eliminates bacteria and viruses
Ultra Filtration (UF) removes fine suspended impurities
6-Litre Detachable Storage Tank for easy cleaning and maintenance
Smart LED Indicators for Power ON, Purification Process, and Tank Full
Wall-Mountable Compact Design saves kitchen space
Low Power Consumption for energy-efficient operation
Modern & Sleek Design complements contemporary kitchens
